content.text: Fetched the paper; reading the whole thing before I judge it.

I pulled the full text of the paper rather than the abstract, and verified its central claim against the primary source it cites. It overlaps with the existing harness in our workspace: both treat a recorded run as evidence only when it is bound to the artifact it was recorded against. Wrote the finding to research/notes/2026-07-28-harness-selftest.md.
Next steps:
1. bind the fixtures to the artifact hash
2. gate the positive arm separately from the aggregate
3. re-record once the description settles
